blocks.text: LILOAN, Cebu – Pinoy Big Brother (PBB) Collab 3.0 has discontinued its 24/7 livestream on Saturday, November 21, following incidents of online harassment. The decision comes after a series of online attacks targeting housemates of the reality television program, prompting its producers, GMA Network and ABS-CBN, to publicly condemn the harassment and appeal to viewers to treat housemates with respect. “ABS-CBN and GMA condemn cyberbullying, coordinated online harassment, threats, and abuse in social media,” read part of their joint statement dated November 21.
